name: hermes-sigil-overlay
description: A privacy-conscious animated activity overlay for Hermes Desktop
author: Tht1guyFromtht1place

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/bridge-security.js && node --check src/bridge-server.js && node --check src/plugin-installer.js && node --check hermes-bridge/plugin.js
scripts.pack:win: npm test && npm run check && npm run audit:release && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --arm64 --ia32 --publish never && npm run audit:artifacts
scripts.pack:mac: npm test && npm run check && npm run audit:release && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never && npm run audit:artifacts
scripts.pack:linux: npm test && npm run check && npm run audit:release && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --arm64 --publish never && npm run audit:artifacts
